doc.title: Rusty Dedrick interviewed by Monk Rowe, Ellenville, New York, June 23, 1998

title: Parents' reaction and road life
summary: His parents wanted a farmer and a minister; he got over homesickness and roomed with Gozzo.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: What did your parents think of this?
They didn’t envision me as a traveling musician that’s for sure. They wanted me to be a farmer. And my brother Art they wanted to be a Methodist minister. And we failed them.
Say mom and dad, you had the instruments there so what are we going to do?
Did you like being on the road?
